fieldValues.title: A ratified rule and the practice running today say opposite things, and nothing notices
fieldValues.statement: Rulings D4, D5 and D15 (ratified 2026-10-16) say an issue is not work until it is grounded and routed, and the handbook repeats it. Since clerk#156 the code grades care instead and refuses nothing for lack of confidence, a position never ratified. Nothing checks records against each other or against the practice they describe, so contradictions surface only when someone trips over them.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-24, reviewing the flow map (clerk#180); flow map clerk#180; clerk#156; decisions D4, D5, D15
